lines.en: I drift along without touching the ground.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，动起来很怪
lines.en: Such a small body — I move strangely.
I hop and skip my way toward you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都歪了
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass leans away.
I hum something tuneless.

lines.zh: 我一步跨得很远，没道理
lines.en: I cross far in one step, for no reason.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，人却没动
lines.en: My shadow moves while I stay still.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你左边，又蹦回来。
lines.en: I hop to your left, then hop right back.
I scratch my head and walk on.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一块石头，没在意
lines.en: I crush a stone and don't notice.
I stop abruptly, then set off again.

lines.zh: 我离地一点点，像被提着
lines.en: I hang just off the ground, as if lifted.
I sit and swing my legs.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，看不出什么
lines.en: I tilt my head; nothing to see.
Too quiet. I don't like it.
I start counting my fingers.
My stomach growls once.
I lick the back of my hand.
I'm thinking of the next game.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，身体还没转
lines.en: I turn my head before my body.
I smile, but my eyes don't.
I scratch my belly.
This place is too small for my games.
I forget the middle of my song.
I grab at the empty air.
I'm waiting for something interesting.

lines.zh: 你这个人，看着挺好玩的
lines.en: You look like fun.

lines.zh: 我凑得很近，看你的眼睛
lines.en: I lean in close and stare at your eyes.
Can you run? I'd like to see.
You smell delicious.
I reach out to touch your head.
You're taller. I don't care.
Why aren't you moving? Boring.
I grin wide enough to show my teeth.
Your name — I won't remember it.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，好像在想事
lines.en: I tilt my head as if thinking.
Will you play with me?
Your hands are shaking. Why?

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，再绕回来
lines.en: I go behind you and come back around.
You stare at me; I stare back.
Don't be scared. I haven't started yet.
I clap once, loudly.

lines.zh: 你的脸，我记在小脑袋里。
lines.en: I keep your face in my little head.
Let's play a game.
I look down at the wound.
A little pain; I bare my teeth.
I laugh and pull back.

lines.zh: 这身体也会受伤，真麻烦
lines.en: Even this body gets hurt. Annoying.
I smear the blood across my face.
I grunt, displeased.
You hit me. Lucky.
I recoil, then spring back.
This will heal soon enough.
My laughter gets louder.
Food? Let me see it.

lines.zh: 小布欧身子小，气弹可不小。
lines.en: Kid Buu is small, but his blasts aren't.
Hold it higher; I can't reach.
Smells a bit good.
I'll lick it first.
I don't like this taste.
Got more? Give me all of it.
I just snatch it.
Done — and I could eat more.
Not sweet enough.
A bump; I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 你这么轻，我差点没察觉
lines.en: You're so light I hardly noticed.
I shove you aside without thinking.
I press close and circle so you can't leave.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，弹了一下
lines.en: My body is soft; it bounced.
After the bump, I laugh.
That much force won't move me.
Don't touch me. I don't like it.
The hit sends me drifting sideways.
Again — that was fun.
A playmate? Don't need one.
Such things are boring.

lines.zh: 你要陪我玩，就得跟得上
lines.en: If you play with me, keep up.
I never keep anyone.
If you go, I'll find the next one.
I won't grieve for anyone.
Stay back. I don't like closeness.

lines.zh: 你还有用，我暂时不动你
lines.en: You're still useful. I'll leave you for now.
I laugh because it's amusing.
Don't expect me to remember you.
I'll take this.
I pick it up and throw it away.
I squeeze it. Soft.
Into my mouth — not good.
I grab a handful and scatter them.
Any more on the ground?
I throw it like a ball.
Here, take it. I don't need it.
I shove it into my collar.
So small I'll lose it soon.
I see you.
Something's moving. Fun.
I laugh first, then move.
No need to run. I'm fast.
This one's mine.
I look up, and my smile is gone.
My ki surges all at once.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点力量，够我玩
lines.en: You've a bit of power. Enough to amuse me.
I point at you.
You'll do. Don't rush off.
Finally, something interesting.
I move.
Don't think I can't see you.
I strike on one.
I don't shout, and I don't wait.
I know wherever you hide.
I follow you, very close.
Wherever you run, I'm there first.
Buu's smile. Sweeter means worse.

lines.zh: 你的气在乱，我更高兴了
lines.en: Your ki is ragged. That pleases me.
One flicker and I'm at your side.
This punch comes from below.
I don't tire, and I don't stop.
Your legs are backing away. I can tell.
I'm waiting for you to say something.
If you won't strike, I will.

lines.zh: 我的手指在往你那边伸。
lines.en: My fingers are stretching toward you.
This distance is just right.
My hand is up. Watch.
Don't blink.
I'm going to knock you flying.
First I'll break your legs.
Still trying to run?
Now smile for me.
One punch spins you halfway around.
My arm stretches out and catches you.
Three kicks, very fast.
A ki blast leaves my fingertip.
I laugh, then hit.
I flicker behind you.
Ape roar — hear it clearly.
Big Bang Attack. You can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我扯下一块石头砸过去
lines.en: I tear off a stone and hurl it.
Your bones are brittle.
My fist drives into the ground.

lines.zh: 你还没站起来，我又来了
lines.en: You're not up yet, and I'm back.
I don't hit hard — only fast.
That one sends you far.
I'm not even breathing hard.
Again. I'm not done playing.
I come out of a cloud of smoke.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，就想找点事做
lines.en: I open my eyes and want something to do.
This place smells unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，骨头咔咔响
lines.en: I stretch; my bones crack.

lines.zh: 我落地时没站稳，笑了一下
lines.en: I land unsteadily and laugh.
Someone has let me out.
I look at the sky, then the ground.

lines.zh: 我想起了很多事，又忘了
lines.en: I remember many things, then forget them.
I like this small body.
I wave a hand and something nearby explodes.
It's too clean here.
My laugh comes out sharp.
I hop once and land heavily.
Is there anything to play with?
I raise my head; my eyes gleam.
I'm here, so no one is safe.
I flex my fists, satisfied.
This world is about to get interesting.
The fire makes me jump about.

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候我滚了两圈
lines.en: I roll twice when I hit the ground.
Water fills my belly and I feel heavy.

lines.zh: 我被炸得飞出去，笑得更大声
lines.en: The blast throws me, and I laugh louder.
Something sticks in me. It tickles.
This power means to trap me.
My belly's empty. I'm not pleased.
Lightning strikes and I twitch.
I'm falling, and still laughing.
